test_title: PYST 74: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 24 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: An article is sold for ₹747 after successive discounts of 17% and x%. If the marked price of the article is ₹1,600, what is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Price after 1st discount of 17% = 1600 × (100 − 17)% = 1600 × 83% = ₹1328

Selling Price after 2nd discount (x%) = ₹747

Amount of 2nd discount = 1328 − 747 = ₹581

Value of x = (581 ÷ 1328) × 100 = 43.75

**∴ The correct answer is 43.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹1,600

Selling Price (SP) = ₹747

First discount (D₁) = 17%

Second discount (D₂) = x%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/035c80a4da8e162cfdcd98c208dfdd538f7cf3b3b66ae563ffd3e91392992a1a.png] 

**Formula Used:**

SP = MP × (1 − D₁/100) × (1 − D₂/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 747 = 1600 × (1 − 17/100) × (1 − x/100)

⇒ 747 = 1600 × (83/100) × (1 − x/100)

⇒ 747 = 1328 × (1 − x/100)

⇒ 1 − x/100 = 747 ÷ 1328

⇒ 1 − x/100 = 9/16

⇒ x/100 = 1 − 9/16

⇒ x/100 = 7/16

⇒ x = (7 × 100) ÷ 16

⇒ x = 700 ÷ 16 = 43.75

**∴ The correct answer is 43.75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP) and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) of the article. SP = MP − Discount.

Successive Discounts

When two discounts of x% and y% are given successively, the equivalent single discount percentage is [x + y − (x × y)/100]%.

Profit/Loss Percentage

Profit or Loss is always calculated on the Cost Price (CP) unless stated otherwise. Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100.
